outline.title: Seven-month smart-home horizon for Nicoletta Palmi
outline.note: Home-centred outline for a healthy 42-year-old high-school professor living in a large villa near Rimini.

attributes.description: Villa balcony and outdoor drying area
Rimini marina where her boat is kept

recurringActivities.label: Breakfast at home
recurringActivities.note: Usually before leaving for school; later on weekends.

recurringActivities.label: Morning prescribed medication
recurringActivities.note: Represents birth-control pill intake only on the prescribed days of her cycle.

recurringActivities.label: Evening hygiene
recurringActivities.note: Routine bathroom care before winding down.

recurringActivities.label: Cook dinner
recurringActivities.note: She enjoys cooking; lighter preparation is used as the nearest canonical dinner-preparation intent.

recurringActivities.label: Watch films or television
recurringActivities.note: Often a film on free evenings.

recurringActivities.label: Gym session
recurringActivities.note: Nearest supported intent; the actual gym is away from home and only the exercise pattern is represented.

recurringActivities.label: Weekly meal preparation
recurringActivities.note: Batch preparation for the teaching week.

recurringActivities.label: Hang laundry
recurringActivities.note: Usually follows the weekly wash when weather permits.

authoringAssumptions: Nicoletta lives alone because no household members were specified.
The seven-month horizon starts on 2026-08-04 and ends on 2027-03-03 inclusive.
Her teaching commitment is modeled Monday through Friday from 08:00 to 14:00 during the school term, excluding a winter holiday phase.
Gym attendance is represented by the nearest supported canonical intent, indoor_light_exercise, because detailed away-from-home gym activity is outside the home-centred catalog.
Boat use is represented as bounded weekend leave-home events during warm weather because the catalog has no boating intent.
Birth-control medication is modeled as a daily morning medication routine, with the note that actual use follows her prescribed cycle.
The chronotype bedtime was set to 22:15 so deterministic sleep jitter cannot move a preferred sleep start into the following calendar date while retaining the activity under the previous day.

habits.label: Night and sleep
habits.note: Starts more than two hours before the 22:15 chronotype bedtime and keeps rhythm-generated sleep starts safely on the same calendar day.

habits.label: Morning preparation
habits.note: Breakfast and medication before school or a slower weekend start.

habits.label: Daytime commitments and home tasks
habits.note: Teaching dominates weekdays; household tasks occupy free days.

habits.label: Evening meal and leisure
habits.note: Exercise, cooking and dinner before the night band; later hygiene and quiet leisure may occur within the night transition.

fixedCommitments.label: Teaching shift at Idioms High School
fixedCommitments.note: Regular school-day teaching hours; the winter-holiday phase suspends home routines but does not rewrite this commitment.

phases.label: Late-summer boat season
phases.note: Warm weekends are more often reserved for the boat, so gym frequency decreases.

phases.label: Winter indoor routine
phases.note: Colder evenings increase indoor film and television time.

phases.label: Winter school holidays
phases.note: Later mornings and more cooking while school is closed.

events.label: Weekend boat outing
events.note: Represents leaving home for a warm-weather day on her boat; boating itself is outside the catalog.

events.label: Holiday dinner away from home
events.note: A seasonal social dinner outside the villa; represented by the nearest canonical absence intent because the catalog does not provide a generic relative-dinner intent consistently across its declarations.

events.label: Seasonal villa reorganization
events.note: A larger seasonal tidying session using the nearest supported housekeeping intent.
